items.raw_excerpt: Portimão is preparing to celebrate one of the Algarve’s best-known traditions as the Festival da Sardinha returns to the city’s riverside from 4 to 9 August, bringing together live music, gastronomy and family entertainment with free admission throughout the event.
items.summary_en: Portimão is preparing for the Festival da Sardinha from August 4 to 9. The event brings live music, food, and family entertainment to the city's riverside. Admission is free throughout the festival.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 포르티망에서 8월 4일부터 9일까지 사르디냐 축제가 열립니다. 라이브 음악과 음식, 가족 단위 프로그램이 시내 강변에서 마련됩니다. 모든 행사는 무료로 진행됩니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Projeto de lei institui polo moveleiro em Santa Felicidade, em Curitiba (PR), com oito objetivos para fortalecer o setor no bairro
items.summary_en: A bill has been introduced to create a furniture industry hub in Santa Felicidade, a neighborhood in Curitiba, Brazil. The proposal includes eight objectives to strengthen the furniture sector in the area.

items.raw_excerpt: July 27 : Two-time Olympic champion Jakob Ingebrigtsen is set to compete for the first time this year at next month's European Athletics Championships in Birmingham, the Norwegian runner announced on Monday.The 25-year-old middle and long-distance runner has been sidelined with an Achilles issue since competi
items.summary_en: Two-time Olympic champion Jakob Ingebrigtsen will compete at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham next month. This will be his first race of the year after recovering from an Achilles injury.

items.raw_excerpt: Plans to build the world’s first commercial octopus farm have been abandoned following years of criticism from scientists, animal welfare organisations and environmental groups.
items.summary_en: Plans to build the world's first commercial octopus farm have been dropped. Scientists and animal welfare groups opposed the project for years.

items.raw_excerpt: National may be proposing to increase the amount of paid parental leave that new parents are allowed to take, but about half of all New Zealand employers are already offering more than the statutory minimum.
items.summary_en: New Zealand's opposition National party may increase the statutory minimum for paid parental leave. But about half of all New Zealand employers already offer more than what the law requires.

items.raw_excerpt: Le village de Champdieu dans la Loire offre aux portes de Lyon, une escapade parfaite entre patrimoine culturel et gastronomique.
items.summary_en: Champdieu is a small village in the Loire region, about 1 hour 20 minutes from Lyon. It is surrounded by vineyards and holds a millennium-old priory. The village is doubly certified as an Art and History town and a Wine & Discoveries destination.
items.summary_ko: 샹디외는 리옹에서 1시간 20분 거리에 있는 로아르 지역의 작은 마을입니다. 마을은 포도밭으로 둘러싸여 있으며 천년 된 사원이 있습니다. 이 마을은 예술과 역사 도시, 그리고 포도와 발견 두 가지 인증을 동시에 받았습니다.
items.title_en: A Village Near Lyon Hides a 1000-Year-Old Priory Among the Vines

items.title_original: À 1h20 de Lyon, ce village entouré de vignes cache un prieuré millénaire lui permettant d’être doublement labellisé « Villes et Pays d’art et d’histoire » ainsi que « Vignobles & Découvertes » - Lyon Secret

items.raw_excerpt: Publicação descreve longa como mistura "de tensão, drama e violência explosiva sustentada pela atuação excepcional de Wagner Moura"
items.summary_en: A British magazine listed the Brazilian film 'O Agente Secreto' among the best movies of the year. The publication praised actor Wagner Moura's exceptional performance. The magazine also described the city of Recife as a small city.

items.title_original: Revista britânica elege 'O Agente Secreto' entre os melhores do ano e cita Recife como 'cidade pequena' - JC

items.raw_excerpt: Much of the country had a frosty start with a second day of cold early morning temperatures.
items.summary_en: A bitter cold snap brought freezing temperatures to much of New Zealand. The country experienced a second day of cold early morning conditions with frosty starts.

items.raw_excerpt: One of television’s most recognisable homes has been put up for sale in California, with the mansion used as the exterior of Wayne Manor in the classic 1960s “Batman” series returning to the property market with an asking price of approximately €27 million.
items.summary_en: The California mansion used as Wayne Manor in the classic 1960s Batman series is up for sale. The asking price is about €27 million. The home is one of the most recognizable houses from vintage television.
items.summary_ko: 1960년대 배트맨 TV 시리즈에서 Wayne Manor로 사용된 캘리포니아 저택이 매물로 나왔다. 매매 가격은 약 2700만 유로다. 이 집은 클래식 TV 시리즈에서 가장 유명한 집 중 하나로 꼽힌다.
items.title_en: 1960s Batman TV series mansion goes on sale for €27 million

items.raw_excerpt: The digital reconstruction of a charcoal mural has revealed the earliest known evidence of calendrical writing in Calakmul, Campeche.
items.summary_en: Scientists used modern technology to study an old charcoal drawing. They found the oldest known calendar writing from the ancient Maya city of Calakmul in Mexico.
